currentCard.prompt: Что из перечисленного помогает крови остановить кровотечение, собираясь у повреждённой стенки сосуда?

answers.note: В общем анализе крови число тромбоцитов оценивают отдельно от числа эритроцитов и лейкоцитов.
Эритроциты содержат гемоглобин, который переносит кислород от лёгких к тканям.
Лейкоциты входят в иммунную систему и помогают бороться с инфекциями и другими заболеваниями.
При биохимическом анализе в плазме измеряют, например, глюкозу, кальций и электролиты.

currentCard.explanation: Тромбоциты — фрагменты клеток крови, которые слипаются у небольших повреждений стенки сосуда. Так они помогают остановить кровотечение.

source.title: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NIH): Blood Tests

literal.prompt: Что из перечисленного помогает крови остановить кровотечение, собираясь у повреждённой стенки сосуда?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NHLBI L91 explicitly identifies platelets as blood-cell fragments sticking together to seal vessel-wall breaks and stop bleeding. L89 gives erythrocyte oxygen transport; L90 immune white cells; L122 fluid plasma and L157 soluble clotting-protein tests. The key-discriminating qualifier is aggregation at the injured vessel wall, not merely ANY participation in coagulation: plasma proteins also affect clotting but fluid plasma is not the aggregating platelet component. Exactly slot0 fits the full prompt. All four are real blood components with comparable standalone names.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NHLBI L91 directly says platelets are blood-cell fragments, help clotting, stick together and seal cuts/breaks in vessel walls to stop bleeding. Both card sentences accurately restate this, without claiming platelet aggregation alone is the entire clotting cascade. Two clear Russian sentences explicitly name platelets. The minor vessel-wall-break phrasing remains in the source’s normal injury context.

absoluteLevel.ground: MEDIUM: a player familiar with basic blood physiology can distinguish platelet aggregation from red-cell transport, immune white cells and fluid plasma/coagulation proteins. For a player outside the theme these are all real blood components, and recognizing that blood clots or guessing from a familiar term need not resolve which component performs local aggregation; the other options cannot all be rejected as nonblood entities. It is accessible thematic recall, not HARD specialist cascade knowledge. The CBC extra note is not needed to answer; no appeal to the author’s frozen label, page accessibility or QA as difficulty evidence.

correctNoteExtraFact.fact: CBC assesses platelet count separately from red-cell and white-cell counts.
correctNoteExtraFact.ground: The prompt/key/explanation ask platelet aggregation at a vessel injury; the separate laboratory count is an additional concrete own-platelet fact supported by L88-L91 and the separate table rows L100-L103.
